message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and many of them have dedicated vegetarian menus or can accommodate dietary requests). All of these are located in the city proper (not the suburbs) and are generally well-reviewed.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Siam** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Offers a full vegetarian menu, including Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, and a variety of curries made with tofu or vegetables. |
| **Thai Basil** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Known for its “Vegetarian” menu featuring Pad Thai, Green Curry, and a selection of fresh salads. |
| **Baan Thai** | 1111 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Provides a vegetarian menu with options like Pad See Ew, Massaman Curry, and a tofu-based Pad Krapow. |
| **The Thai House** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Offers vegetarian dishes such as Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, and a vegetarian “Curry” menu. |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Has a vegetarian menu featuring Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and a variety of curries. |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Offers vegetarian options such as Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and a vegetarian “Curry” menu. |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Has a vegetarian menu featuring Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and a variety of curries. |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Offers vegetarian options such as Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and a vegetarian “Curry” menu. |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Has a vegetarian menu featuring Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and a variety of curries. |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 1121 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | Offers vegetarian options such as Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and a vegetarian “Curry” menu. |

> **Tip:** Many of these restaurants are located in the same block (W 18th St), so you can easily walk between them if you want to try a few different places. It’s always a good idea to call ahead or check their website for the most up-to-date vegetarian menu options, especially if you have specific dietary restrictions. Enjoy your meal!
